option.name: SCRIPT_TEXT
option.value: pkill -f 'target/debug/roer-server'; lsof -ti:4317 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; (cd src-tauri && cargo run --bin roer-server > /tmp/roer-server.log 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 60); do grep -qo 'token=[^ ]*' /tmp/roer-server.log 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 0.5; done; URL=$(grep -o 'http://localhost:1420/api/session?token=[^ ]*' /tmp/roer-server.log); if [ -n "$URL" ]; then echo "opening $URL"; open "$URL"; else echo "roer-server did not start in time, check /tmp/roer-server.log"; fi
